name: gizza-ai/csv-row-index-adder
summary: Add sequential, UUID, or composite key columns to CSV rows

tool.description: Add a generated key column to CSV text. mode=sequential inserts row numbers with start, step, zero-padding, prefix and suffix. mode=uuid adds one v4 random or v7 time-ordered UUID per data row. mode=composite builds a key by joining existing columns. Choose whether the input has a header, where the new column is inserted, and whether the delimiter is auto-detected or fixed to comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe. Returns updated CSV text.

column_name.description: Header for the new column. Leave blank to use index, uuid, or key based on mode.

columns.description: Composite mode only: comma-separated source columns, by header name or 1-based number, to join into the key.

data.description: CSV or delimited text to update. Paste the full table; the output preserves CSV quoting and the chosen delimiter.

delimiter.description: Input delimiter. auto sniffs comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe from the first non-empty line; output uses the same delimiter.

has_header.description: Treat the first row as a header row. When true, the first row receives column_name instead of a generated value.

mode.description: Generated value type: sequential numbers, UUIDs, or a composite key joined from existing columns.

pad_width.description: Zero-pad sequential numbers to this many digits (0-64). Prefix and suffix are added after padding.

position.description: Where to insert the generated column: at the start, at the end, before a reference column, or after a reference column.

prefix.description: Text prepended to each generated value, e.g. INV-.

reference_column.description: Header name or 1-based column number used when position is before or after.

separator.description: Composite mode separator between source column values. Default '-' .

start.description: First sequential number. Use 0 for zero-based indexing. Ignored unless mode is sequential.

step.description: Increment between sequential numbers. Negative steps count down; zero is rejected. Ignored unless mode is sequential.

suffix.description: Text appended to each generated value, e.g. -2026.

uuid_format.description: UUID rendering: standard lowercase with hyphens, uppercase, compact no-hyphens, braces, or urn.

uuid_version.description: UUID mode only: v4 random UUIDs or v7 time-ordered UUIDs.
